scope: Physical lake, without optional legacy bridge; no global economic deduplication

ids_panel.semantics: Nonmissing provider values, including reported zeroes and future-dated entries. These are not all realized historical observations; after_retrieval_year is a calendar flag, not a forecast classification. Native estimate/forecast fields remain unchanged. Missing source cells are retained in silver. Native creditor entities include institutions and historical entities; they are not a country count. WLD is flagged separately; other aggregate codes are not guessed. No creditor summation, interpolation, zero-filling or currency-denomination inference. Latest successful retrieval resolves overlapping requests.

tests.scope: All tests/data_lake tests, including 21 original contract tests and 20 stdlib tests plus new creditor-view test

limitations: Full global coverage/series-dictionary report was not recomputed; previous baseline includes legacy bridge. New IDS/QPSD measurements are separate.
IDS sample is an incomplete acquisition, not a balanced panel or all 134 debtors.
Future-dated values are provider numbers, not established historical realizations.
Existing 10 failed jobs remain recorded; no mass retry.
